meta.title: Whale Blockade
meta.description: Whale Blockade: a blockade-style HUD skin. Translucent panels float over a starfield with a neural lattice; one adjustable accent marks focus (7 presets plus a custom picker, default deep-sea blue). Syncs its accent with dsh-chara-soul when both are installed.

title: Whale Blockade · HUD
hint: These switches affect the readout panel and the background only. Turn the master switch off to get the stock interface back.
